source: Marc Jamoulle, e-mail reply to the 2026-06-04 results.xlsx (100 rows checked, 8 flagged)
note: Marc's reading is an agreement target, not ground truth. 'accept' lists the codes we treat as agreeing with his reading after checking each code in the pinned release and on ontology.jax.org (2026-10-21). null in 'accept' means an uncoded row is acceptable.

rows.why: HPO has no ear-fullness term. Blocked Eustachian tube (HP:0040269) is closer but the search does not shortlist it.

rows.patient_verbatim: les acouphènes, ils me réveillent la nuit
rows.marc_comment: wrong the right code for Tinnitus is HP:0000360
rows.why: Tinnitus was the top candidate. The judge rule 'pick the most specific term' chose a child the patient never described.

rows.patient_verbatim: J'ai l'impression de me retrouver comme après mon accident de voiture.
rows.marc_comment: wrong code, HP:5200290 = Difficulty processing information
rows.why: The judge declined the shortlist; the top candidate was shown with REVIEW and confidence 0. The verbatim is a comparison, not a finding. HP:5200290 is Exploding head syndrome in HPO; HPO has no 'Difficulty processing information' term.

rows.patient_verbatim: Me déplacer en voiture, mais est-ce que c'est lié au vertige ?
rows.marc_comment: wrong code, Photophobia et Vertige pas pris en compte
rows.why: Same fallback as above. Vertigo (HP:0002321) is already a separate MGA.404 row. The transcript has no light-sensitivity words.

rows.patient_verbatim: Un poids sur la poitrine ? Une douleur au niveau du sternum ? Non, ça, ça va.
rows.marc_comment: the correct code for Chest pain is HP:0100749
rows.why: Denied findings were deliberately left uncoded (Robinson #6). Marc wants the code with Absent.

rows.patient_verbatim: Parfois, j'ai des douleurs au rein.
rows.marc_comment: good semantic, wrong code HP:0002907 Flank pain
rows.why: HP:0030157 is Flank pain in HPO. HP:0002907 is Microscopic hematuria.

rows.patient_verbatim: La capacité de concentration ? Oui, ça a été affecté, c'est sûr.
rows.marc_comment: wrong semantics, mental concentration and not chemical one
rows.why: HP:0031987 is not in the top 5 for 'impaired concentration' (all five are chemical). The judge declined; the top candidate was shown.
HPO has no white-tongue term. HP:0031466 is Impairment in personality functioning.
